title: Context Clues — Comprehension & Reading Strategies
skills: infer the meaning of unfamiliar words
use surrounding words and phrases as clues

alignment_note: Teaches students how to use surrounding words, phrases, examples, and sentence structure to infer the meaning of unfamiliar vocabulary. Supports transferable vocabulary development, close reading, and comprehension skills across high school English courses.
